services.name: Business Registration Certificate
services.description: Timeline: 48 working hours from receipt of a complete application. The listed fees are non-refundable.
requirements: Power of Attorney / Letter of Authority where applicable
Proof of payment of processing fee

requirements.title: Source note
items: The company’s Annual Returns Filing with CAC must be up to date.

processSteps: Log in to the SWIP portal (swip.nipc.gov.ng).
Complete the online form and upload the required documents.
Pay the processing fee online.
NIPC reviews and processes the application within 48 working hours from receipt of a complete application.
The certificate is issued electronically.

services.name: Economic Development Incentive — New Application
services.description: Timeline: 12 weeks total — Part I (NIPC): 4 weeks; Part II (FMITI / IID): 4 weeks; Part III (NRS): 4 weeks.
processSteps: Apply to NIPC with the requisite fee.
Agree on a presentation date.
Present the project to NIPC.
NIPC performs due diligence and a site visit.
The NIPC Technical Committee makes a decision: approve or request additional information.
NIPC submits to the Minister for review and onward submission to the President.
Presidential approval.
NIPC issues the EDI Certificate.
Part II: Apply to IID for Production Duty Certification.
IID issues the Production Duty Certificate.
Part III: Apply to NRS for QCE Certification.
NRS issues a Qualifying Capital Expenditure (QCE) Certificate.

services.name: Export Certificate Registration
services.description: Responsible service agency: Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC). This is the NIPC / OSIC SLA listing; NEPC administers the certificate. Timeline: 48 working hours after confirmation of payment.

requirements.title: Limited Liability Company
items: Certificate of Incorporation issued by CAC
Copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Copy of Form CAC 1.1 — Section C (Particulars of Directors) or Status Report. The source notes this was formerly Form CO7 or Form CAC 7.
Board resolution to register the company with NEPC (Company Seal affixed and signed).

requirements.title: Co-operative Society
items: Certificate of Registration issued by the appropriate State Ministry of Commerce, Local Government or FCT Area Council as applicable
Board resolution to register with NEPC (Society Seal affixed and signed).

requirements.title: Government and Non-Government Organisations
items: Certificate of Registration issued by the Corporate Affairs Commission
Constitution of the Government Organisation or Non-Governmental Organisation
Board of Trustees resolution to register with NEPC (Company Seal affixed and signed).

processSteps: Visit nepc.gov.ng and open Getting Started to read about E-registration.
Select TAKE ME THERE to open the NEPC E-registration platform.
Select Create an Account.
Create an account using an email address (company email preferred) and enter the security code.
Select Verify E-mail.
Open the email from NEPC and follow its verification link.
Create a password and continue to the E-registration platform.
Complete the forms.
Upload the documents in PDF format when prompted.
Proceed to make payment.

evidence.title: Nigerian Investment Promotion Commission — Service Level Agreement
evidence.notes: NIPC SLA section 6.3 lists Export Certificate Registration under NEPC, its timeline, fees, organisation-specific documents and process.

services.paymentGuide: NEPC administers this service through its E-registration platform. Confirm the current route in NEPC’s official channel.
